audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 row treats Noxious Trap as the reason 6 stays even and says a blind 'mid-dash' shuts you down.
audit.why: Highlander makes you immune to all slowing effects for its duration, so while it is up the mushrooms are damage and vision only — their slow, which is the part that actually stops a Yi, does nothing. What keeps 6 even is the flat 7s Blinding Dart outpacing a no-item all-in, not the shrooms.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten around Highlander's slow immunity versus shroom slows and the 7s blind window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart is said to blank 'Alpha Strike's follow-up entirely' and 'your Alpha Strike on-hit'. The R is called Noxious Traps in four places. No cooldown is ever given for the blind.
audit.why: Blind stops BASIC ATTACKS. That is still devastating here — Wuju Style's true damage, Double Strike and every on-hit item effect all ride on autos — but Alpha Strike is a spell: its own damage lands, and you are untargetable while it runs, which is your one clean answer. Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, and that number is the whole matchup. The ult is Noxious Trap, singular.
audit.corrected: Blind scoped to basic attacks with the 7s cooldown stated; Alpha Strike's spell damage and untargetability preserved; Noxious Trap named correctly.

edits.before: Teemo dominates levels 1-3: his Blinding Dart (Q) turns off your autos and Alpha Strike's follow-up entirely, and Toxic Shot poison plus Move Quick (W) kiting chip you for free. Never approach when his Q is up; a single blind wastes your whole trade.
edits.after: Teemo dominates levels 1-3: Blinding Dart (Q) is a flat 7s that blanks every basic attack, so Wuju Style, Double Strike and all your on-hit go to zero, while Toxic Shot and Move Quick (W) chip you for free. Alpha Strike's own damage still lands.

edits.before: Teemo drops Noxious Traps (R) at 6 that zone you and reveal ganks, keeping the mid-lane skill-based; your Highlander (R) speed helps you close, but a blind mid-dash still shuts you down. Buy an early Oracle/sweeper and only commit when his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: Teemo drops Noxious Trap (R) mushrooms at 6 that zone you and reveal ganks, but Highlander makes you immune to their slow while it runs, leaving them damage and vision only. Buy a sweeper, and commit inside the 7s his Blinding Dart is down.

edits.before: Track Blinding Dart (Q) above all — it is the entire matchup. Its cooldown is your only window: when it is down, Teemo cannot stop your autos or Alpha Strike on-hit, so every engage must be timed to a Q he has already used. Secondarily note his shroom (R) placements in brush and on the wave.
edits.after: Track Blinding Dart (Q) above all — a flat 7s at every rank, and the entire matchup. Once it is spent Teemo cannot stop a single auto, so every engage is timed to a Q he has already used and has to finish inside those seven seconds. Secondarily note his shroom placements in brush and on the wave.

edits.before: Blinding Dart blanks your autos, your Alpha Strike on-hit, AND your E Wuju Style true damage — it is the core counter. Your counterplay is Alpha Strike's untargetability (it dodges his Q and any incoming auto during the blink) and the fact that one blind on a cooldown is not enough to stop a fully itemized on-hit combo. Meditate out-sustains his poison chip between trades.
edits.after: Blinding Dart blanks every basic attack — Wuju Style's true damage, Double Strike and all your on-hit ride on autos, so all of it goes to zero — but Alpha Strike is a spell, its damage still lands, and you are untargetable for the blink. It is a flat 7s, not enough to stop a fully itemized combo. Meditate out-sustains his poison chip between trades.

edits.before: A genuine 51.6% EVEN coinflip of two halves — Teemo blinds and kites you out of the early lane, but you scale through one blind into a 1v9 skirmisher the moment BORK and Highlander land; discipline on his Q cooldown and your item timer decides it.
edits.after: A genuine 50% EVEN coinflip of two halves — Teemo blinds and kites you out of the early lane, but you scale through one blind into a 1v9 skirmisher the moment BORK and Highlander land; discipline on his 7s Q and your item timer decides it.

notes: The packet's suspectName on "Alpha Strike's" is a false positive — that is the correct name with a possessive. The other flag is genuine: the ult is Noxious Trap, singular, and the page wrote 'Noxious Traps' four times. The substantive fix is scoping the blind: it stops basic attacks, which is where all of Yi's damage lives, but not Alpha Strike itself — the page said it blanked Alpha Strike, which would make the matchup unplayable and is not what the ability does. Level chart matches the packet, no chart edits.
